comments.author: Simon
comments.text:
Hi Rukku,

Unfortunately there is no fast or easy way to get a 7.5, which is a very high score. You need to work hard on improving all aspects of your English. By following this website every day, you are definitely doing something that will help you to improve, but it will take quite a long time to get from intermediate to 7.5

Keep working hard

Simon

comments.author: Simon
comments.text:
Hi Agung, It's difficult for me to say what you are doing wrong. Maybe you make too many mistakes, maybe you have problems with fluency, vocabulary or pronunciation.

I think you need to practise with a teacher and ask him or her to analyse your problems.

Keep working hard and you will improve!

Simon
